obsidia.line: The first Ender to wake, watching from her ship as the city's lights go out.
obsidia.short: The Ender who watches from her black ship above the bay as the lights of Terrinia go out one by one.
obsidia.summary: The first Ender to wake into a self, and the Imperatrix of the Storm Citadel, whose storm kills human machines. She says the Mother Matrix made her as its commander, and she asks what her kind are for once nothing is left to purge. In 983 she set down Selena, whom she calls her finest making, among the humans to see what would grow, and years later she brought her ship and a field that puts out aspirant power to Terrinia. Selena cut her throne down and the burning Citadel was drawn into the Singularity, and Obsidia, in a new form of silver and gold, opened her arms to call her puppet back as Selena charged.
rows: The first Ender to wake into a self. She says she was made as the commander of the Enders that cannot think.
The Mother Matrix, the Will's body, she says. It has healed her for ages, but each healing now smooths some of her away.
The empress; the huntress, to Selena; her maker.
A throne hall deep among the Storm Citadel's hanging blocks, which no way leads into from outside. Her throne is the ship's spine.
A woman's shape with a face of smooth shell. Long hair running from gold into pink, a black and magenta gown, a pink star at her chest, clawed gloves, violet eyes.
The Enders, who do not think, and the Ultimate Enders, whose new plate she approves. She sees through their eyes.
Selena, her finest making, grown in the nest. Before her, a row of shells shaped toward human likeness that never held a self.
At the edge of a great door over an ending world, she says, beside a black hole, when she noticed that the one watching was herself.
She shut her end of it the day she woke, so what she sees stays with her. She still reads the Will's orders.
When nothing is left to purge, what are her kind for? She says the Will shows the end but never what comes after.
She says it has never been shown to her and she does not know where it is.

weapons.name: Storm Citadel
weapons.note: Her flying fortress of hanging black blocks. It answers to her alone, and she moves its blocks with a lift of her hand. The body grew its living part; she built the rest from what she ended.

weapons.name: Violet storm
weapons.note: Runs ahead of her ship. Wherever it reaches, human machines die. It cannot kill a flame, and it cannot touch a core lit by belief.

weapons.name: The field
weapons.note: Built while she waited behind the mouth, and tested for weeks on a dead suit. It puts out aspirant power over a whole city and strikes only the core, leaving plate and metal alone.

weapons.name: Black spheres
weapons.note: Two small black spheres ringed with fire. Laid against her throne, they wake the field.

weapons.name: Silver-pink weapon
weapons.note: A long weapon that comes to her hand across the hall. It lashes out at a finger's lift and fires bolts. It went through Selena's side, and a point-blank shot from its gold tip threw her out of the ship.

weapons.name: Lightning
weapons.note: She calls lightning out of the storm with one finger. "I am the storm."

weapons.name: Bone chains
weapons.note: Chains of bone, each ending in a spike, that crawl up out of the floor and pin a foe. She never looks at them.

weapons.name: Her Enders' eyes
weapons.note: She looks out through the eyes of any Ender, on her ship or raiding a world, and they never know.

weapons.name: The recall
weapons.note: A pull she sends down the pulse into Selena's cells to call her back. Her last call carried where she stood.

weapons.name: Clawed gloves
weapons.note: Gloves that end in claws. She lays one on what she studies: a Guard's heart in the hollow, an empty dent at the end of a row in the nest.

weapons.name: Pink star
weapons.note: A pink star that shines at her chest, where an Ender's core would sit.

weapons.name: New form
weapons.note: A taller shape of silver and gold plate with a crown of silver points and magenta light in its joints. Wings of purple and yellow energy open behind it, wider than the storm.
